row.evidence: Row Zero's pricing page lists "SSO & SCIM" under Enterprise (Custom, Schedule demo), and its SCIM docs say "Enterprise customers can elect to sync users and groups from their identity provider (IdP) using SCIM".
row.notes: Status unchanged from June (gated, Enterprise). Prices: Pro $12 and Business $20 per user/mo billed annually ($15/$25 monthly), Enterprise custom. Team plan moved from Pro to Business because the pricing page labels Pro 'For individual users' and Business 'For teams'. June's '~$30/u/mo' Enterprise figure had no first-party source and is dropped. SSO (SAML or OIDC) is Enterprise-only. SCIM 2.0 at https://scim.rowzero.com/scim/v2 with a Row Zero-issued token; documented for Okta, Entra and JumpCloud as custom/non-gallery apps; SSO must be set up first. No public user-management or audit-log API found. JIT account creation on Business and Enterprise.

auth.token_source: Issued by Row Zero support/team on request (not self-serve in the admin console)

deprovision.notes: Okta guide enables Deactivate Users; Row Zero does not say what deactivation does to the account. Removal from an IdP group removes access to content shared with that group; access itself is cut by SSO.

attributes.notes: Okta guide says to unmap everything except userName and displayName; given/family name are ignored.

limitations.text: SCIM token is issued by Row Zero on request; no self-serve token generation documented.
SSO must be configured before SCIM; SCIM syncs users/groups for sharing typeahead while SSO gates access.
Row Zero is not in the Microsoft Entra gallery; a non-gallery Enterprise app is used.

scim.notes: Row Zero positions SCIM mainly as a user/group directory for sharing typeahead and group-based access; SSO gates actual sign-in.

user_api.notes: No public REST or admin API is listed in Row Zero's docs index (llms.txt) or sitemap; admin membership is managed in the app.

okta.notes: Row Zero's guide builds a custom SAML 2.0 app with SCIM provisioning in Okta; no OIN listing (okta.com/integrations/row-zero/ returned 404).

entra.notes: Non-gallery Enterprise app; Row Zero says Microsoft has paused gallery submissions.

jumpcloud.notes: Row Zero's guide uses a JumpCloud 'Custom Application' with SAML/OIDC and SCIM Identity Management.

fallbacks.other_sync: Business: users with the account's email domain join automatically on sign-up
